Module 1:  Agency, education and innovation (1 hour)

Position of the majority of young [sex of FGD] on the ladder of power and freedom (private rating) – Now: 5 = Power and freedom to make almost all major life decisions: 1 vote; 4 = Power and freedom to make many major life decisions: 3 votes; 3 = Power and freedom to make some major life decisions: 6 votes; 2 = Only a small amount of power and freedom: 0 votes; 1 = Almost no power or freedom to make decisions: 0 votes

In my opinion we are on step 3 going towards steps 4 and step 5 we have to become independent from our parent. Now we don’t have economic and social freedom. if we decide on some major things without their will, our parents may deny us inheritance which is the only option we have to start our life of freedom.

I am a student. I live with my parents. They fulfill my basic needs and I help them with farming. However if I want to study they are not going to influence me somehow I can do what I want to do. And that is why I said I am on step 3.

I thought in our community most of us do not have the power and freedom to make some major life decisions because when you live in your parents house nobody listen to your decision you live on your parent’s rule.
Education for me is about knowing something I don’t know that help me to lead my life with program and help me to take out my potential and use it.
My family lives under poverty the only option to take them out of poverty is through my education. Through education, I can change my life and my family’s life.
Whatever an educated person says every word that comes out of his mouth is meaningful. Therefore education is good.

I hope I will change my life through education. There is no end to education, every day if you allow it has its own lessons to take and when you top it up with going to school, it gives you the power to understand things easily.
Boys grade 8 and Girls grade 10 [why do you stop this early?]
We start to try to make money so instead of continuing we prefer to stop early and make money by going to towns or engaging in income generating activities.
Once you see your friend who has stopped school and is working is making money we tend to be influenced easily.

Some of us lose interest in education because, unlike girls we get jobs easily in for examples some rich people’s house, as shepherds, or laborer. We can also easily travel to town and get dialy jobs and come back.
Till grade 8 if they can read and write that’s enough they know about leading their life by plan and they understand the new innovation.
Early time for girls if they can read and write they make them stop but now they understand the benefit of girl’s education they encourage them to continue.
University degree that helps them to get job as a civil servant.
They did not show commitment to educating their sons because they want them for shepherds and farming.

Parents give more attention for girls, because they are not needed in the house as much as the by does when they grow up. These days, parents also prefer to make their daughter continue her education rather than getting married early. Girls are also in the opinion, that through education they can become someone.

It is expensive to stay in school these days. Especially at the beginning of the year, you need money to cover for expenses such as school materials, books, and uniform. If you do not have the financial resource it is difficult to continue. For instance, I used to work extra as laborer to save money for such expenses, but one year, I could not make it and I stopped going to school, and that is it.
Yes, when I finish school I want to be a driver [why] because it is possible way to come out from being a farmer.

When I finish school my goal was to study medicine I want to help people in my community who are suffer with different illnesses
When I finish school my goal is to become a teacher because I want to create doctors, pilots and scientist
There is no support to start their own work the only chance they had is to work as daily laborer or security to help their family.
Most of them work on agricultural activities.
They get better job and support their family.

99% of the people in our community depend on agriculture for their livelihood. First thing is first we have to keep the soil from erosion and increase the fertility if we do that we can use improved seed and fertilizer. And that means better production and better income. Through water shade management, we can also regulate the rainfall, as the vegetation coverage improve, rain will also improve.
It helps the soil to recover and increase soil fertility so we prefer water shade management.

For women improved chickens is the most important because she can sale the egg and also she chicken if she wants on her own. [what about other assets such as oxen?] let alone her, he cannot take and sale it without discussing and agreeing first with her husband.

Cattle crossbreeding is also important for women because they can benefit from the milk and butter or cottage cheese. She can even sale these things without any permission from him. However, if she wants to sale the cow, that should be based on consent from her husband.
Yes [together]
They have equal opportunities there is no discrimination.

Since few years on wards, there are a lot of changes in our community. Girls are also getting opportunities for training on different things including saving. They are being given even better opportunities by their parents to continue their education. Girls are also aware that education is the only way out for girls in our area. So they are focusing on their studies.

As young people, we do not like this, we prefer if the women do the chores and we focus on agriculture, however, now our fathers are doing it and we are being ordered to help with cleaning, cooking etc.
She faces difficulties [why] because of mainly cultural influence on her even her husband may not accepts her. People may see her walking to the market and say things about her.

it may be difficult for a man to sell the chickens himself. That is a taboo for a man to sell eggs or chicken if he does this the community would dishonor him.
In this regard, it seems there is some injustice because, women can benefit from chicken and cows, but men do not. It is I think unfair.

I feel keeping her busy and engaged all the time is part of the strategy to keep women where they are. They will never get time to think about things that she may otherwise think is injustice.
The men say she won her husband. The women also they see her as a lucky person as she has a husband who understand her and help her to grow.

If a woman is hard worker and also work in the market or even as a laborer, these days there is nothing new attached to it. It is getting common around here. Women are working while their husband is staying at home. However, the only difference is that her husband is overacting and he is a bit strange.
They insult him they even blame God why he creates him like this.
He faces too much criticism from his friend and the community, his mother would be ashamed.
He is very much happy he wants her success because he was thinking differently from the start from the community
Good attitude on women works any kind of work and change their life equally like men
- equality is good thing it bring harmony inside the household and the community. As both recognizes their unique nature and potential to contribute differently to change their life.

It’s a good thing for example I am raised by single mother she works what men and women works we are three children in the house two of us boys and one girl she teach us both equally household chores and farming.

From the beginning they are working together and listen to each other the make the change but when we see it in our community situation he will never accept her. [Why?] because some men think that women are not knowledgeable in farming be it vegetable or crop.
